lines.trans: Hello everyone! I am your new culture editor.
Very nice to meet you. Welcome to our team!
What is your department working on right now?
We are preparing an urgent news broadcast.
I want to do a story about the theatre.
Our audience prefers crime news much more.
But people also need high culture!
High culture does not bring high ratings.
Let us try to find an interesting angle.
Fine, write up a short plan for the story.
I will bring the finished text in an hour.
Agreed, good luck on your first day!
